summary: Wrote a 7-phase, 8.5-hour implementation plan for giving the sapience extension repo-scoped storage and per-dispatch injection. Phases: author sapience-retrieve.sh, author sapience-remember.sh, declare both in the extension manifest, deploy and verify the live tagged-write/repo-filtered-read round trip, swap the dispatch call site plus its test fixture stub, amend the extension design record and document the three hazards, then redeploy and run the full gate set. Every carried figure in the dispatch description was re-validated against live state, with two corrections recorded. Five implementation-shaping facts neither the dispatch nor the research report carried were surfaced and folded into the phases.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan (8.5h, 5 dependency waves) for the two sapience scripts, the manifest declaration, the orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh retrieval swap, and the design-record amendment plus hazard documentation.
